external_entities.name: Store manager
external_entities.description: A store manager who uses the scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Store managers use a scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.

external_entities.name: Colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who uses the scheduling web app to look at assigned shifts and reaches it from their own phone.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues use the same app to look at the shifts they have been given.

external_entities.name: Payroll system
external_entities.description: A payroll system run by another team that collects the payroll export from the file share.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The payroll system, which is run by another team, collects the export from the file share.

processes.name: Scheduling web app
processes.description: A web app used by store managers to build weekly rotas and by colleagues to view assigned shifts.
processes.source_excerpt: Store managers use a scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.

processes.name: Scheduling service
processes.description: A service that reads and writes rotas and writes a weekly payroll export to a file share.
processes.source_excerpt: The scheduling service is what actually reads and writes the rotas, which live in a rota database.

data_stores.name: Rota database
data_stores.description: A database containing rotas, colleague names, contact details and stated availability.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Colleague names, contact details and stated availability are held in that database.

data_stores.name: File share
data_stores.description: A file share receiving a weekly payroll export from the scheduling service.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Once a week the scheduling service writes a payroll export onto a file share.

data_flows.name: build weekly rota
data_flows.source_excerpt: Store managers use a scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.
data_flows.notes: Nobody has documented how colleagues or managers sign in, or whether any of it is encrypted.

data_flows.name: look at shifts
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues use the same app to look at the shifts they have been given.
data_flows.notes: Nobody has documented how colleagues or managers sign in, or whether any of it is encrypted.

data_flows.name: talks to
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web app talks to a scheduling service.
data_flows.notes: Nobody has documented how the web app and the scheduling service identify each other, or whether any of it is encrypted.

data_flows.name: read and write rotas
data_flows.source_excerpt: The scheduling service is what actually reads and writes the rotas, which live in a rota database.
data_flows.notes: Nobody has documented how the scheduling service identify each other, or whether any of it is encrypted.

data_flows.name: write payroll export
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once a week the scheduling service writes a payroll export onto a file share.
data_flows.notes: Nobody has documented how the scheduling service identify each other, how the payroll system is identified when it collects the export, or whether any of it is encrypted.

data_flows.name: collect export
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payroll system, which is run by another team, collects the export from the file share.
data_flows.notes: Nobody has documented how the payroll system is identified when it collects the export, or whether any of it is encrypted.

trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The scheduling service, the rota database and the file share are on the internal network.
